explanation.what: recentErrors takes the last count entries with slice(-count), and returns every entry for a count of 0. It is one of three instances of one shape, in src/errors.ts, src/messages.ts and src/warnings.ts.
explanation.why: This change wrote the three readers and declares 0 a count they accept, the one that hides the section.
explanation.fix: Return an empty list when count is 0, or take entries.slice(Math.max(0, length - count)), in all three readers.

arguments.failureScenario: recentErrors(log, 0) evaluates slice(-0), which is slice(0), and returns every entry rather than none, so a viewer who set the section to 0 to hide it sees the error history. It is one of three readers with this shape; recentMessages in src/messages.ts and recentWarnings in src/warnings.ts fail the same way.
